vibe: Auspicious, premium, grounded, and tactile. Moving away from generic flat SaaS into rich, culturally resonant UI without being garish. Deeply emotional and trustworthy.

headings.usage: Use for Splash text, Main App Header, Category Titles. Never use Inter for this.

body.usage: Legible, modern contrast to the serif headings.

layout_and_spacing.mobile_strategy: The entire app runs in a mobile layout. If deployed on web, restrict container to max-w-md mx-auto h-[100dvh] overflow-y-auto relative shadow-2xl bg-white. Hide scrollbars using custom css.
layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Use generous padding: p-6 or p-8 for sections. Avoid tight, cluttered margins.
layout_and_spacing.cards: Flat background (bg-white), 1px subtle border (border-[#EAE6D7]), rounded-2xl or rounded-xl. NO heavy drop shadows. Rely on border for definition.
layout_and_spacing.bottom_nav: Crystal Glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 border-t border-[#EAE6D7]. Fixed to bottom. Icons must have high contrast active states (Crimson).

components.hero_banner: Image with gradient overlay `bg-gradient-to-t from-black/70 via-black/20 to-transparent` to ensure white text is readable. Text must be APCA compliant.
components.category_bento: Asymmetric bento grid for categories. e.g. 'Gardens' spans full width (col-span-2), 'Pandits' and 'Video' split 50/50 below it (col-span-1 each) in a grid-cols-2 layout.
components.buttons: Solid primary color for main CTA, no gradients. Deep crimson bg, white text. rounded-full or rounded-xl for mobile-friendly tap targets. min-h-[48px].
components.inputs: Shadcn inputs but customized: bg-[#F3EFE6] border-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#B22222].
components.calendar: Shadcn Calendar for date picking, customized with crimson accent.

animations.transitions: Use Framer Motion for page transitions (slide up/fade).
animations.micro_interactions: Hover or Tap states must scale down slightly (scale-95) and reduce opacity. Smooth ease-in-out.

images.description: Indian wedding couple - used for splash or home hero.
Luxury resort and manicured gardens for venue category.
Ganesha under colorful tent - used for Pandit/Pooja category.
Videographer with camera for Photography/Videography category.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Text over images must use text-shadow or gradient scrims to meet 4.5:1 ratio.
accessibility_and_testing.testing_attributes: All interactive elements MUST have `data-testid` in kebab-case (e.g., `data-testid="book-now-button"`).

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the app as a mobile-first responsive web app using Tailwind CSS.
Ensure the layout container mimics a mobile screen if viewed on desktop (max-w-md mx-auto, shadow-2xl, relative, overflow-x-hidden).
Use Shadcn UI primitives but strip away the default generic Vercel look. Apply the colors and border styles defined in these guidelines.
Inject the provided Google Fonts URL into index.css and extend tailwind.config.js to use them as 'heading' and 'sans'.
Implement a sticky bottom navigation bar with Glassmorphism for mobile app feel.
All tap targets (buttons, links, form inputs) must be at least 48px height for mobile usability.
For the booking flow, use Shadcn Calendar (customized to match the warm theme) and provide clear success states.
Include a 'Mock Payment' processing state with a spinner before showing the 'Booking Confirmed' screen.
Strictly follow the `data-testid` requirement for all buttons, inputs, and clickable cards.
